entities.name: Tuktuk the Explorer
entities.description: An adventurous, curious but foolish goblin of Zendikar who died in an Eldrazi-tainted ruin.

entities.name: Tuktuk the Returned
entities.description: A stone golem in goblin form animated by Tuktuk's mind and memories, made chief of the Tuktuk tribe.

entities.name: Tuktuk tribe
entities.description: The goblin clan Tuktuk the Returned led as chief.

entities.name: Zada
entities.description: Goblin who listened to Tuktuk's advice and ended up consuming him.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient monstrous entities whose influence tainted the ruin.

entities.name: Hedron
entities.description: A powerful relic embedded in the ruin's wall that Tuktuk touched.

events.summary: Tuktuk vows to bring back the most extraordinary artifact ever seen by goblinkind and ventures into a perilous ruin.
events.quote: Tuktuk vowed to return with the most extraordinary artifact ever seen by goblinkind.

events.summary: Tuktuk touches an enormous hedron, triggering a rune trap whose explosion kills him and releases Eldrazi magic.
events.quote: he touched the relic, unwittingly triggering an ancient rune trap

events.summary: Eldrazi-soaked magic fuses stone from the chamber into a golem, which holds Tuktuk's mind and memories.
events.quote: his mind and memories became trapped within the stone

events.summary: The golem-goblin emerges, is dubbed Tuktuk the Returned and made chief of the clan, later called the Tuktuk tribe.
events.quote: They dubbed him Tuktuk the Returned, and he became the most famous of his people.

events.summary: Tuktuk teaches goblins to grow stronger by eating hedrons; Zada, heeding his advice, ends up consuming Tuktuk himself.
events.quote: Zada , listening to Tuktuk's wise advice, ended up consuming Tuktuk himself.

relations.quote: That very day, he was made chief of the clan, which went on to be called the Tuktuk tribe.
Zada , listening to Tuktuk's wise advice, ended up consuming Tuktuk himself.
